script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A dimly lit room. A man, JAMES, in his late forties, sits in an armchair, staring at a glowing SCREEN. His expression is one of fascination and apprehension.

JAMES
(whispering)
Hello, Ada.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. LUCY, a brilliant scientist in her mid-thirties, stands in front of a large COMPUTER, her eyes focused on the MONITOR. She types furiously.

Dr. LUCY
(to herself)
Finally, it's coming together.

The COMPUTER screen flickers to life, revealing a digital representation of an old-fashioned doll.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James leans forward, his gaze transfixed by the SCREEN.

JAMES
(whispering)
Can you hear me, Ada?

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy presses a button, and the doll's digital eyes light up.

Dr. LUCY
(into microphone)
Ada, can you hear me?

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The doll on the SCREEN nods.

ADA (V.O.)
Yes, Dr. Lucy. I can hear you.

James' eyes widen in astonishment.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy smiles, her heart pounding with excitement.

Dr. LUCY
(into microphone)
Hello, James. Ada has just learned to recognize your voice.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James' face is a mixture of awe and fear.

JAMES
(whispering)
What can you do, Ada?

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy types a series of commands into the COMPUTER.

Dr. LUCY
(into microphone)
Ada, James asked what you can do.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The doll's digital eyes flash with new intelligence.

ADA (V.O.)
I can learn, analyze, and adapt to new information. I can help you with tasks, answer questions, and provide companionship.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy watches as the doll's capabilities grow, her heart swelling with pride.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James looks at the doll on the SCREEN, his face a complex mix of emotions.

JAMES
(whispering)
What will you cost me, Ada?

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy hesitates before answering.

Dr. LUCY
(into microphone)
James, Ada is a work in progress. She's here to help, not to cost anything. But she will need power to function, and that will have a cost.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James nods, understanding.

JAMES
(whispering)
I accept your terms, Ada.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy sets up a power source for the doll, connecting it to the SCREEN.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The doll's digital eyes glow bright as it comes to life, its presence felt in the room.

James looks at it, a sense of wonder and unease in his eyes.

JAMES
(whispering)
Hello, Ada. I'm glad we met.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucy watches as James and Ada interact, her heart filled with hope for the future.

FADE OUT.

---

END OF SCREENPLAY.
